thesis_title: Heuristic Pathfinding Optimization on Spatial Grids: Weighted Octile A* vs. Dijkstra
thesis_statement: Weighted A* with octile heuristic expands fewer nodes than Dijkstra on dense grids, with negligible sub-optimality.

planned_chapters.title: Experimental Setup and Results
planned_chapters.focus: Metrics, graphs comparing expansion count and cost.
